classdef.name: ColorGroupSwatches
classdef.shortdesc: A collection of color group swatches.

parameter.name: swatchItemRef
parameter.shortdesc: swatch to be added to color group

parameter.name: withProperties
parameter.shortdesc: Initial values for properties of the new ColorGroupSwatch (Optional)

method.name: count
method.shortdesc: Displays the number of elements in the ColorGroupSwatch.

method.name: item
method.shortdesc: Returns the ColorGroupSwatch with the specified index or name.

parameter.name: index
parameter.shortdesc: The index or name. Can accept: Long Integer or String.

method.name: itemByID
method.shortdesc: Returns the ColorGroupSwatch with the specified ID.

method.name: itemByRange
method.shortdesc: Returns the ColorGroupSwatches within the specified range.

parameter.name: from
parameter.shortdesc: The ColorGroupSwatch, index, or name at the beginning of the range. Can accept: ColorGroupSwatch, Long Integer or String.

parameter.name: to
parameter.shortdesc: The ColorGroupSwatch, index, or name at the end of the range. Can accept: ColorGroupSwatch, Long Integer or String.

method.name: firstItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the first ColorGroupSwatch in the collection.

method.name: lastItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the last ColorGroupSwatch in the collection.

method.name: middleItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the middle ColorGroupSwatch in the collection.

method.name: previousItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the ColorGroupSwatch with the index previous to the specified index.

parameter.name: obj
parameter.shortdesc: The index of the ColorGroupSwatch that follows the desired ColorGroupSwatch.

method.name: nextItem
method.shortdesc: Returns the ColorGroupSwatch whose index follows the specified ColorGroupSwatch in the collection.

parameter.name: obj
parameter.shortdesc: The ColorGroupSwatch whose index comes before the desired ColorGroupSwatch.

method.name: anyItem
method.shortdesc: Returns any ColorGroupSwatch in the collection.

method.name: everyItem
method.shortdesc: Returns every ColorGroupSwatch in the collection.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the ColorGroupSwatch.
Returns the ColorGroupSwatch with the specified index.

property.name: length
property.shortdesc: The number of objects in the collection.
